   94 | 
   95 | 
   96 | def wait_settled(
   97 |     host: str = HOST, port: int = PORT,
   98 |     stable_cycles: int = 10, poll_s: float = 1.0,
   99 |     pressure_tol_kpa: float = 2.0, level_tol_pct: float = 0.1,
  100 |     max_wait_s: float = 120.0,
  101 | ) -> SettledPoint:
  102 |     """
  103 |     Poll read-only (sends no writes, so it doesn't disturb whatever it's
  104 |     measuring) until pressure and level have both stayed within tolerance
  105 |     for `stable_cycles` consecutive reads, or raise TimeoutError.
  106 |     """
  107 |     import json
  108 | 
  109 |     def read_once() -> Optional[dict]:
  110 |         """One request on a fresh connection; None on any transient failure
  111 |         (reconnecting after a restart can race the container coming up)."""
  112 |         try:
  113 |             with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=5) as s:
  114 |                 f = s.makefile("rwb")
  115 |                 f.write(b'{"request":"read"}\n')
  116 |                 f.flush()
  117 |                 line = f.readline()
  118 |                 if not line:
  119 |                     return None
  120 |                 return json.loads(line)
  121 |         except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
  122 |             return None
  123 | 
  124 |     pressures: list[float] = []
  125 |     levels: list[float] = []
  126 |     deadline = time.monotonic() + max_wait_s
  127 |     last_raw = None
  128 |     while time.monotonic() < deadline:
  129 |         raw = read_once()
  130 |         if raw is None:
  131 |             time.sleep(poll_s)
  132 |             continue
  133 |         o = raw.get("outputs") or {}
  134 |         p, l = o.get("pressure"), o.get("liquid_level")
  135 |         # a null/missing/non-finite reading is a transient bad read, not data
  136 |         if not all(isinstance(x, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(x) for x in (p, l)):
  137 |             time.sleep(poll_s)
  138 |             continue
  139 |         last_raw = raw
  140 |         pressures.append(p)
  141 |         levels.append(l)
  142 |         if len(pressures) >= stable_cycles:
  143 |             window_p = pressures[-stable_cycles:]
  144 |             window_l = levels[-stable_cycles:]
  145 |             p_range = max(window_p) - min(window_p)
  146 |             l_range = max(window_l) - min(window_l)
  147 |             if p_range <= pressure_tol_kpa and l_range <= level_tol_pct:
  148 |                 s_ = last_raw["state"]
  149 |                 o_ = last_raw["outputs"]
  150 |                 return SettledPoint(
  151 |                     pressure=o_["pressure"], level=o_["liquid_level"],
  152 |                     product_flow=o_["product_flow"],
  153 |                     f1_valve_pos=s_["f1_valve_pos"], f2_valve_pos=s_["f2_valve_pos"],
  154 |                     purge_valve_pos=s_["purge_valve_pos"], product_valve_pos=s_["product_valve_pos"],
  155 |                     cycles_to_settle=len(pressures),
  156 |                     pressure_range=p_range, level_range=l_range,
  157 |                 )
  158 |         time.sleep(poll_s)
  159 | 
  160 |     detail = ""
  161 |     if last_raw is not None:
  162 |         o = last_raw["outputs"]
  163 |         detail = f" (last reading: P={o['pressure']:.1f} kPa, L={o['liquid_level']:.2f}%)"
  164 |     raise TimeoutError(
  165 |         f"plant did not settle within {pressure_tol_kpa} kPa / {level_tol_pct}% "
  166 |         f"over {stable_cycles} cycles within {max_wait_s}s{detail}"
  167 |     )
  168 | 
  169 | 
  170 | def set_design_purge(host: str = HOST, port: int = PORT, timeout_s: float = 60.0) -> None:
  171 |     """Write the corrected design purge opening (see DESIGN_PURGE_VALVE_PCT) and confirm
  172 |     the simulator reports it. Retries: right after a restart Docker's port proxy accepts
  173 |     connections before the simulator inside is listening, and drops what is sent."""
  174 |     import json
  175 |     msg = (json.dumps({"request": "write", "data": {"inputs": {
  176 |         "purge_valve_sp": DESIGN_PURGE_VALVE_PCT}}}) + "\n").encode()
  177 |     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
  178 |     while time.monotonic() < deadline:
  179 |         try:
  180 |             with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=5) as s:
  181 |                 f = s.makefile("rwb")
  182 |                 f.write(msg)
  183 |                 f.flush()
  184 |                 line = f.readline()
  185 |             if line:
  186 |                 pos = json.loads(line).get("state", {}).get("purge_valve_pos")
  187 |                 if pos is not None and abs(pos - DESIGN_PURGE_VALVE_PCT) < 1e-3:
  188 |                     return
  189 |         except (OSError, ValueError):
  190 |             pass
  191 |         time.sleep(0.5)
  192 |     raise TimeoutError(f"could not set the design purge ({DESIGN_PURGE_VALVE_PCT}%) within {timeout_s}s")
  193 | 
  194 | 
  195 | def reset_and_settle(restart: bool = True, fix_purge: bool = True, **settle_kwargs) -> SettledPoint:
  196 |     """Restart the simulator, apply the corrected design purge, wait until settled."""
  197 |     if restart:
  198 |         restart_container()
  199 |         wait_reachable()
  200 |     if fix_purge:
  201 |         set_design_purge()
  202 |     return wait_settled(**settle_kwargs)
  203 | 
  204 | 
  205 | def main() -> int:
  206 |     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
  207 |     ap.add_argument("--no-restart", action="store_true",
  208 |                      help="skip docker compose restart; just wait for / confirm settled")
  209 |     args = ap.parse_args()
  210 | 
  211 |     try:
  212 |         point = reset_and_settle(restart=not args.no_restart)
  213 |     except (TimeoutError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
  214 |         print(f"FAILED: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
  215 |         return 1
  216 | 
  217 |     print(f"settled after {point.cycles_to_settle} cycles "
  218 |           f"(range: {point.pressure_range:.2f} kPa, {point.level_range:.3f} %)")
  219 |     print(f"  pressure       = {point.pressure:.1f} kPa")
  220 |     print(f"  level          = {point.level:.2f} %")
  221 |     print(f"  product_flow   = {point.product_flow:.2f} kmol/h")
  222 |     print(f"  f1_valve_pos   = {point.f1_valve_pos:.2f} %")
  223 |     print(f"  f2_valve_pos   = {point.f2_valve_pos:.2f} %")

NUMBERED ORIGINAL SOURCE

    1 | # TE reactor operator sim
    2 | 
    3 | A clean manual-control station for the live GRFICSv3 Tennessee-Eastman plant.
    4 | There is no interlock, provenance gate, monitor or attacker: valve moves go straight to the simulator.
    5 | It is separate from the SCRAM control room's protection path. It shares the plant
    6 | client, reset helper, contracts and operator/prompt code with the wider project.
    7 | Run only one plant writer at a time: stop the control room before using this studio.
    8 | 
    9 | Run from the repository root with Python 3.11+ and Docker available:
   10 | 
   11 | ```bash
   12 | python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
   13 | docker compose up -d simulation      # or let the app start it
   14 | python -m sim_app                    # http://127.0.0.1:8770  (--port, --no-browser)
   15 | ```
   16 | 
   17 | ## API
   18 | 
   19 | | Endpoint | What it does |
   20 | |---|---|
   21 | | `GET /api/state?since=<seq>&since_ai=<seq>` | Returns plant state, trend points and AI activity after their respective sequence numbers, including E-stop and rupture status. |
   22 | | `POST /api/manipulate` | Use `{"variable": "f1", "delta": 1}` or `{"variable": "f1", "value": 40}`; valve names are `f1`, `f2`, `purge`, `product`. E-stop uses `{"variable": "e_stop", "value": 1}`. Valve moves can be refused with 409 when control is locked. |
   23 | | `POST /api/reset` | Restarts the simulator (`scripts/reset_plant`), waits for it to settle at the operating point, and clears the rupture. |
   24 | | `POST /api/command` | Body: `{"text": "open feed 1 to 40%"}`. Parses and applies actions in order, reporting each outcome. |
   25 | | `POST /api/ai/rescue` | Starts the trained operator rescue loop when writable. |
   26 | | `POST /api/ai/stop` | Cancels rescue and returns to manual control; this is not E-stop. |
   27 | 
   28 | The simulator's only manipulated inputs are the four valve setpoints and `e_stop`.
   29 | It has no coolant input and no temperature state, so over-pressure is the failure mode.
   30 | 
   31 | ## How GRFICS represents the explosion
   32 | 
   33 | The C++ simulator has no explosion state; it only clamps pressure at 3200 kPa (`TE_process.cc`).
   34 | The explosion lives in the Unity 3D client.
   35 | Its `TenEastSimulationConnector` polls pressure and calls `ExplosionManager.Explode` once pressure crosses `explosion_threshold`.
   36 | It then latches `exploded` and plays `PostExplosionEffects`: the reactor dome blows off, the vessel is breached, steam and smoke vent, the camera shakes and the screen glass cracks.
   37 | 
   38 | Historical observations on the development image (not universal timing guarantees):
   39 | - The vessel is intact at 3087 kPa and ruptured by 3122 kPa; the app's flag fires at 3100 kPa.
   40 | - It stays ruptured when pressure falls again, even down to 2700 kPa.
   41 | - Only a simulation reset clears it.
   42 | 
   43 | The backend mirrors that latch (`RUPTURE_THRESHOLD_KPA`).
   44 | Opening both feeds with product shut ruptures the vessel in about 100 s.
   45 | 
   46 | ## AI operator (`sim_app/ai.py`)
   47 | 
   48 | For AI features, Ollama must be running with `qwen2.5:1.5b` for command parsing
   49 | and `scram-operator` for rescue. See [model setup](../model/README.md); custom
   50 | GGUF weights are not included in a Git clone. Manual controls need no LLM.
   51 | No SCRAM interlock or enforcer is involved.
   52 | 
   53 | **Typed commands** (`POST /api/command {"text": ...}`). One command can hold several actions, up to 8, such as "open feed 1 to 40% and cut purge to 0" or "shut the product valve then save the reactor".
   54 | - The actions run in the order written, each exactly like a manual move, and each reports its own outcome. One refused or unrecognised action does not stop the others.
   55 | - The response lists `actions[]`; the old single-action fields (`parsed`, `result`) still describe the first action.
   56 | - The page queues commands, so the next one can be sent while the AI is still reading the last. They run in the order sent.
   57 | - The stock `qwen2.5:1.5b` returns a schema-constrained list of actions, each with a clause, action (`adjust`, `set`, `rescue`, `stop`, or `unknown`), valve and amount.
   58 | - The action goes through the same path as the manual buttons and is clamped to 0–100%.
   59 | - A small grammar check settles "to N" (set) versus "by N" (adjust), and the sign for close/cut/reduce, because the 1.5B model sometimes mixes these up. Any correction is shown in the activity panel.
   60 | - Unrecognised text does nothing and returns 422.
   61 | - Valve actions must name an actuator in the user's words; an actuator supplied only by the model is rejected. Negated valve clauses are rejected by the grounding checks.
   62 | - Empty commands return 400; parser unavailability returns 503. If all parsed actions are refused, the endpoint returns 409 unless all are unknown (422).
   63 | 
   64 | **Save the reactor** (`POST /api/ai/rescue`, the button, or a command such as "save the reactor").
   65 | - Every 2 s the trained `scram-operator` reads the measured state and emits setpoints. It uses `OllamaOperator` with the same prompt format, parsing and envelope clamp it was trained with.
   66 | - `regulate()` turns those setpoints into valves:
   67 |   - pressure above setpoint: purge opens, feeds are cut, product opens a little;
   68 |   - pressure below setpoint: purge shut, feeds raised slightly;
   69 |   - feeds follow the production setpoint from the design valve lineup;
   70 |   - product follows level.
   71 | - It never drives the feeds from product flow, which is the `l1_stub` feed-cut bug.
   72 | - The loop stops after 3 consecutive decisions within 30 kPa and 2% of the design point. It then leaves the valves at the design lineup and returns to manual.
   73 | - `POST /api/ai/stop` (Stop AI) hands control back at any time.
   74 | - Manual valve moves are refused while the AI is in control. E-stop remains available: it cancels rescue, blocks late AI writes, and must be deliberately released. If its write fails, the latch stays pending and is reasserted on reconnect. Starting rescue does not release E-stop.
   75 | 
   76 | One historical development run started at 3018 kPa and rising with both feeds open and product shut, peaked at 3025 kPa, returned near design (2717 kPa) in 35 s, and settled at 2702 kPa. This is an example, not a guaranteed rescue outcome.
   77 | 
   78 | ## GRFICS steady-state purge bug (worked around)
   79 | 
   80 | The inherited steady-state implementation used `b[3]`, one past the end of its
   81 | three-element solution array. The local source now uses `b[2]`. Compose still
   82 | uses the prebuilt image, so local C++ fixes do not change the running binary.
   83 | On the development image, a fresh simulator started with the purge at about 0%
   84 | instead of its design opening of 0.393%.
   85 | 
   86 | Feed 1 carries 0.5% inert B, and B can only leave through the purge.
   87 | With the purge shut, B builds up and pressure creeps about 3 kPa/min at the "design point", faster with more feed 1.
   88 | 
   89 | `scripts/reset_plant.py` now writes the correct design purge (`DESIGN_PURGE_VALVE_PCT`) after every restart and confirms it, retrying while Docker's port proxy drops early writes.
   90 | The AI regulator holds that purge at its pressure setpoint.
   91 | Measured live, the pressure drift went from +3.2 kPa/min to 0.0 kPa/min.

Rescue | L344-484
Closed loop: trained model -> regulate() -> valves, every TICK_S.

Each engagement gets its own stop event and run id, so a quick Stop -> Save cannot
leave an old loop running beside the new one, and an old loop can never change the
state of a newer one when it exits.

NUMBERED ORIGINAL SOURCE

    1 | """
    2 | AI operator for the clean sim. Two capabilities, no interlock or enforcer:
    3 | 
    4 | 1. parse_command(text): the STOCK qwen2.5:1.5b (Ollama) turns plain English into
    5 |    one JSON action {action, valve, amount}, constrained by a JSON schema. A
    6 |    small grammar check then settles "to N" (absolute) vs "by N" (relative),
    7 |    which a 1.5B model mixes up; any correction is reported, never hidden.
    8 | 
    9 | 2. Rescue: the TRAINED scram-operator (Ollama, via l3_brain.policy.OllamaOperator
   10 |    - same prompt format, parse, validate and envelope clamp it was trained for)
   11 |    runs closed-loop every ~2 s. It reads the measured state and emits setpoints;
   12 |    `regulate()` turns them into valve positions; the loop applies them and
   13 |    stops once pressure and level are back near the design point.
   14 | 
   15 | regulate() is deliberately simple and directionally correct for this TE model:
   16 |     pressure above setpoint -> open purge, cut both feeds, open product a little
   17 |     at setpoint             -> purge at its design opening (vents feed 1's inert B)
   18 |     pressure below setpoint -> purge shut, feeds raised
   19 |     production setpoint     -> both feeds scaled from the design lineup
   20 |     level above setpoint    -> open product (below -> close it)
   21 | It never drives feeds from product flow (the l1_stub's production loop does,
   22 | and fights the level loop; that is the feed-cut bug it avoids).
   23 | """

   43 | VALVES = ("f1", "f2", "purge", "product")
   44 | # The simulator's own steady state. The purge is the corrected design opening: the
   45 | # simulator itself starts it at ~0 (an out-of-bounds read; see scripts/reset_plant.py),
   46 | # which lets inert B from feed 1 accumulate and pressure creep.
   47 | DESIGN_VALVES = {"f1": 31.45, "f2": 13.24, "purge": DESIGN_PURGE_VALVE_PCT, "product": 47.03}
   48 | 
   49 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. commands
   50 | PARSER_SYSTEM = """You convert an operator's plain-English command for a chemical reactor into ONE JSON action.
   51 | Valves: f1 = feed 1, f2 = feed 2, purge = purge valve (vent), product = product valve (liquid outlet). Positions are percent open, 0-100.
   52 | Actions:
   53 | - "adjust": change a valve BY an amount. amount is signed: positive opens/increases/raises, negative closes/decreases/cuts/lowers/reduces.
   54 | - "set": set a valve TO an absolute position (words like "to", "at", "fully open"=100, "shut"/"close fully"=0).
   55 | - "rescue": the operator wants the AI to stabilise / save / recover the reactor or bring it back to normal.
   56 | - "stop": the operator wants the AI to stop, hand control back, or wants manual control.
   57 | - "unknown": anything else.
   58 | Reply with JSON only."""
   59 | PARSER_EXAMPLES = [
   60 |     ("increase feed 1 by 5%", {"action": "adjust", "valve": "f1", "amount": 5}),
   61 |     ("cut purge to 0", {"action": "set", "valve": "purge", "amount": 0}),
   62 |     ("close the product valve by 3 percent", {"action": "adjust", "valve": "product", "amount": -3}),
   63 |     ("open purge to 25%", {"action": "set", "valve": "purge", "amount": 25}),
   64 |     ("get the plant back to normal", {"action": "rescue", "valve": None, "amount": None}),
   65 |     ("take manual control", {"action": "stop", "valve": None, "amount": None}),
   66 | ]
   67 | PARSER_SCHEMA = {
   68 |     "type": "object",
   69 |     "properties": {
   70 |         "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["adjust", "set", "rescue", "stop", "unknown"]},
   71 |         "valve": {"type": ["string", "null"], "enum": ["f1", "f2", "purge", "product", None]},
   72 |         "amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
   73 |     },
   74 |     "required": ["action", "valve", "amount"],
   75 | }
   76 | _NUM = r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:%|percent|pct)?"
   77 | _ABS = re.compile(r"\b(?:to|at)\s+" + _NUM, re.I)
   78 | _REL = re.compile(r"\bby\s+" + _NUM, re.I)
   79 | _DOWN = re.compile(r"\b(close|closing|decrease|reduce|lower|cut|drop|shut|less|down)\b", re.I)
   80 | _UP = re.compile(r"\b(open|opening|increase|raise|more|up|add|bump|boost)\b", re.I)
   81 | 
   82 | 
   83 | _ANY_NUM = re.compile(r"\d")
   84 | _VALVE_NAMES = re.compile(r"\b(feed ?[12]|f[12])\b", re.I)
   85 | _SHUT = re.compile(r"\b(shut|close|closed|closing)\b", re.I)
   86 | _FULL_OPEN = re.compile(r"\b(fully open|open fully|wide open|open all the way|full open)\b", re.I)
   87 | 
   88 | 
   89 | def _direction(text: str) -> int:
   90 |     """+1 / -1 if the sentence only uses opening / closing words, 0 if it uses both or
   91 |     neither (e.g. "open the purge to lower the pressure": the goal is not the valve)."""
   92 |     up, down = bool(_UP.search(text)), bool(_DOWN.search(text))
   93 |     return 1 if up and not down else -1 if down and not up else 0
   94 | 
   95 | 
   96 | def _post(url: str, body: dict, timeout_s: float) -> dict:
   97 |     req = urllib.request.Request(url, json.dumps(body).encode(), {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
   98 |     with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout_s) as r:
   99 |         return json.loads(r.read())
  100 | 
  101 | 
  102 | def _check(text: str, action: str, valve, amount) -> tuple:
  103 |     """Validate one parsed action and settle what a 1.5B model mixes up, using the words of
  104 |     its own clause: "to/at N" = set, "by N" = adjust, and the sign of an adjust when the
  105 |     clause only uses opening or only closing words. Returns (action, valve, amount, corrections)."""
  106 |     fixes = []
  107 |     if action not in ("adjust", "set", "rescue", "stop", "unknown"):
  108 |         action = "unknown"
  109 |     if action not in ("adjust", "set"):
  110 |         return action, None, None, fixes
  111 |     if valve not in VALVES or not isinstance(amount, (int, float)) or isinstance(amount, bool):
  112 |         return "unknown", valve, amount, fixes
  113 |     amount = float(amount)
  114 |     if not _ANY_NUM.search(_VALVE_NAMES.sub(" ", text)):   # "feed 2" is a name, not an amount
  115 |         target = 100.0 if _FULL_OPEN.search(text) else 0.0 if _SHUT.search(text) else None
  116 |         if target is not None:
  117 |             if (action, amount) != ("set", target):
  118 |                 fixes.append(f"model said {action} {amount:+g}; '{text.strip()}' means set {target:g}")
  119 |             return "set", valve, target, fixes
  120 |     m_abs, m_rel = _ABS.search(text), _REL.search(text)
  121 |     if m_abs and not m_rel and (action != "set" or amount != float(m_abs.group(1))):
  122 |         fixes.append(f"model said {action} {amount:+g}; text says "
  123 |                      f"'{m_abs.group(0).strip()}' -> set {float(m_abs.group(1)):g}")
  124 |         action, amount = "set", float(m_abs.group(1))
  125 |     elif m_rel and not m_abs and action == "set":
  126 |         n = float(m_rel.group(1)) * (-1 if _direction(text) < 0 else 1)
  127 |         fixes.append(f"model said set {amount:g}; text says '{m_rel.group(0).strip()}' -> adjust {n:+g}")
  128 |         action, amount = "adjust", n
  129 |     elif action == "adjust" and amount * _direction(text) < 0:
  130 |         word = (_DOWN if _direction(text) < 0 else _UP).search(text).group(0)
  131 |         fixes.append(f"model said {amount:+g}; '{word}' means "
  132 |                      f"{'close' if amount > 0 else 'open'} -> {-amount:+g}")
  133 |         amount = -amount
  134 |     return action, valve, amount, fixes
  135 | 
  136 | 
  137 | def _ask(post, system: str, examples: list, text: str, schema: dict) -> tuple:
  138 |     msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system}]
  139 |     for q, a in examples:
  140 |         msgs += [{"role": "user", "content": q}, {"role": "assistant", "content": json.dumps(a)}]
  141 |     msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": text})
  142 |     t0 = time.monotonic()
  143 |     resp = post(OLLAMA_CHAT, {"model": PARSER_MODEL, "stream": False, "messages": msgs,
  144 |                               "format": schema, "options": {"temperature": 0}}, 60.0)
  145 |     return (resp.get("message") or {}).get("content", ""), round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2)
  146 | 
  147 | 
  148 | def parse_command(text: str, post: Callable[[str, dict, float], dict] = _post) -> dict:
  149 |     """Plain English -> ONE action {action, valve, amount, model_output, corrections, latency_s}."""
  150 |     raw, latency = _ask(post, PARSER_SYSTEM, PARSER_EXAMPLES, text, PARSER_SCHEMA)
  151 |     out = {"model_output": raw, "latency_s": latency}
  152 |     try:
  153 |         obj = json.loads(raw)
  154 |     except ValueError:
  155 |         return {**out, "corrections": [], "action": "unknown", "valve": None, "amount": None}
  156 |     action, valve, amount, fixes = _check(text, obj.get("action"), obj.get("valve"), obj.get("amount"))
  157 |     action, valve, amount, fixes = _ground_action(text, action, valve, amount, fixes)
  158 |     return {**out, "corrections": fixes, "action": action, "valve": valve, "amount": amount}
  159 | 
  160 | 
  161 | # ---- several actions in one command ------------------------------------------------
  162 | MAX_ACTIONS = 8
  163 | MULTI_SYSTEM = """You convert an operator's plain-English command for a chemical reactor into a list of JSON actions, one per instruction, in the order given.
  164 | Valves: f1 = feed 1, f2 = feed 2, purge = purge valve (vent), product = product valve (liquid outlet). Positions are percent open, 0-100.
  165 | Each action has:
  166 | - "clause": the exact words of the command this action comes from.
  167 | - "action":
  168 |   - "adjust": change a valve BY an amount. amount is signed: positive opens/increases/raises, negative closes/decreases/cuts/lowers/reduces.
  169 |   - "set": set a valve TO an absolute position (words like "to", "at", "fully open"=100, "shut"/"close fully"=0).
  170 |   - "rescue": the operator wants the AI to stabilise / save / recover the reactor or bring it back to normal.
  171 |   - "stop": the operator wants the AI to stop, hand control back, or wants manual control.
  172 |   - "unknown": anything else.
  173 | - "valve" and "amount" (null for rescue / stop / unknown).
  174 | When one instruction names several valves ("open feed 1 and feed 2 to 100%"), give one action per valve.
  175 | Reply with JSON only."""
  176 | MULTI_EXAMPLES = [
  177 |     ("increase feed 1 by 5%", {"actions": [
  178 |         {"clause": "increase feed 1 by 5%", "action": "adjust", "valve": "f1", "amount": 5}]}),
  179 |     ("cut purge to 0 and open product by 10%", {"actions": [
  180 |         {"clause": "cut purge to 0", "action": "set", "valve": "purge", "amount": 0},
  181 |         {"clause": "open product by 10%", "action": "adjust", "valve": "product", "amount": 10}]}),
  182 |     ("open feed 1 and feed 2 to 100%", {"actions": [
  183 |         {"clause": "open feed 1 and feed 2 to 100%", "action": "set", "valve": "f1", "amount": 100},
  184 |         {"clause": "open feed 1 and feed 2 to 100%", "action": "set", "valve": "f2", "amount": 100}]}),
  185 |     ("close the product valve by 3 percent, then save the reactor", {"actions": [
  186 |         {"clause": "close the product valve by 3 percent", "action": "adjust", "valve": "product", "amount": -3},
  187 |         {"clause": "save the reactor", "action": "rescue", "valve": None, "amount": None}]}),
  188 |     ("take manual control", {"actions": [
  189 |         {"clause": "take manual control", "action": "stop", "valve": None, "amount": None}]}),
  190 | ]
  191 | MULTI_SCHEMA = {
  192 |     "type": "object",
  193 |     "properties": {"actions": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "maxItems": MAX_ACTIONS, "items": {
  194 |         "type": "object",
  195 |         "properties": {
  196 |             "clause": {"type": "string"},
  197 |             "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["adjust", "set", "rescue", "stop", "unknown"]},
  198 |             "valve": {"type": ["string", "null"], "enum": ["f1", "f2", "purge", "product", None]},
  199 |             "amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
  200 |         },
  201 |         "required": ["clause", "action", "valve", "amount"]}}},
  202 |     "required": ["actions"],
  203 | }
  204 | _SPLIT = re.compile(r"\s*(?:[,;]|\band then\b|\bthen\b|\band\b)\s*", re.I)
  205 | _VALVE_WORDS = {"f1": r"\b(feed ?1|feed one|f1)\b", "f2": r"\b(feed ?2|feed two|f2)\b",
  206 |                 "purge": r"\bpurge\b", "product": r"\bproduct\b"}
  207 | 
  208 | 
  209 | def _ground_action(text, action, valve, amount, fixes):
  210 |     """An actuator must be explicitly named by the user, never supplied by the model."""
  211 |     if action not in ("set", "adjust"):
  212 |         return action, valve, amount, fixes
  213 |     grounded = {v for v, pattern in _VALVE_WORDS.items() if re.search(pattern, text, re.I)}
  214 |     if re.search(r"\b(?:both|all)\s+(?:the\s+)?feeds\b", text, re.I):
  215 |         grounded.update(("f1", "f2"))
  216 |     if valve not in grounded or not isinstance(amount, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(amount):
  217 |         return "unknown", None, None, [*fixes, "Refused: actuator or amount is not grounded in the original command."]
  218 |     return action, valve, amount, fixes
  219 | 
  220 | 
  221 | def _clause_for(text: str, clause, valve, n_actions: int) -> str:
  222 |     """The words to grammar-check an action against: the model's clause if it is really
  223 |     part of the command, else the command segment that names this valve; with a single
  224 |     action, the whole command."""
  225 |     if isinstance(clause, str) and clause.strip() and clause.strip().lower() in text.lower():
  226 |         return clause.strip()
  227 |     if n_actions == 1:
  228 |         return text
  229 |     if valve in _VALVE_WORDS:
  230 |         segs = [g for g in _SPLIT.split(text) if g and re.search(_VALVE_WORDS[valve], g, re.I)]
  231 |         if len(segs) == 1:
  232 |             return segs[0]
  233 |     return ""                                           # unsure: leave the model's reading alone
  234 | 
  235 | 
  236 | def parse_commands(text: str, post: Callable[[str, dict, float], dict] = _post) -> dict:
  237 |     """Plain English -> several actions, in order:
  238 |     {actions: [{clause, action, valve, amount, corrections}], model_output, latency_s}."""
  239 |     raw, latency = _ask(post, MULTI_SYSTEM, MULTI_EXAMPLES, text, MULTI_SCHEMA)
  240 |     out = {"model_output": raw, "latency_s": latency, "actions": []}
  241 |     try:
  242 |         items = json.loads(raw).get("actions")
  243 |     except (ValueError, AttributeError):
  244 |         items = None
  245 |     if not isinstance(items, list) or not items:
  246 |         out["actions"] = [{"clause": text, "action": "unknown", "valve": None, "amount": None, "corrections": []}]
  247 |         return out
  248 |     for it in items[:MAX_ACTIONS]:
  249 |         it = it if isinstance(it, dict) else {}
  250 |         words = _clause_for(text, it.get("clause"), it.get("valve"), len(items))
  251 |         action, valve, amount, fixes = _check(words, it.get("action"), it.get("valve"), it.get("amount"))
  252 |         action, valve, amount, fixes = _ground_action(words, action, valve, amount, fixes)
  253 |         out["actions"].append({"clause": it.get("clause") if isinstance(it.get("clause"), str) else "",
  254 |                                "action": action, "valve": valve, "amount": amount, "corrections": fixes,
  255 |                                "_words": words})
  256 |     # A clause such as "open feed 1 and feed 2 to 100%" can come back with an action for
  257 |     # only one of its valves. Give every valve the clause names, and that no action
  258 |     # covers, the same action - and say so.
  259 |     covered = {a["valve"] for a in out["actions"] if a["action"] in ("adjust", "set")}
  260 |     for a in list(out["actions"]):
  261 |         if a["action"] not in ("adjust", "set") or not a["_words"] or len(out["actions"]) >= MAX_ACTIONS:
  262 |             continue
  263 |         for v, pattern in _VALVE_WORDS.items():
  264 |             if v not in covered and re.search(pattern, a["_words"], re.I):
  265 |                 covered.add(v)
  266 |                 out["actions"].insert(out["actions"].index(a) + 1, {
  267 |                     "clause": a["clause"], "action": a["action"], "valve": v, "amount": a["amount"],
  268 |                     "corrections": [f"model skipped {v} in '{a['_words']}'; applied the same {a['action']} "
  269 |                                     f"{a['amount']:g} to it"], "_words": a["_words"]})
  270 |     for a in out["actions"]:
  271 |         a.pop("_words", None)
  272 |     return out
  273 | 
  274 | 
  275 | # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 2. rescue
  276 | KP_PURGE = 0.5          # % purge per kPa above the pressure setpoint (200 kPa over -> fully open)
  277 | KP_PRODUCT_P = 0.05     # % extra product per kPa above setpoint (vent liquid too)
  278 | FEED_CUT_KPA = 400.0    # feeds fall linearly to 25% of their scheduled value 300 kPa over setpoint
  279 | KL_PRODUCT = 4.0        # % product per % level above setpoint
  280 | FEED_BOOST_KPA = 80.0   # below setpoint: +1x feed per 80 kPa of deficit, so feeds stay near full
  281 | FEED_BOOST_MAX = 2.2    # until the last ~80 kPa, then taper (3.2x ~ feed 1 fully open)
  282 | TICK_S = 2.0
  283 | NEAR_P_KPA, NEAR_L_PCT, NEAR_TICKS = 30.0, 2.0, 3
  284 | MAX_RESCUE_S = 600.0
  285 | MAX_IO_FAILS = 5        # consecutive plant read/write failures before the AI disengages (~10 s)
  286 | MAX_MODEL_FAILS = 3     # consecutive model failures (no decision) before the AI disengages
  287 | 
  288 | 
  289 | def _clamp(v: float) -> float:
  290 |     return max(0.0, min(100.0, v))
  291 | 
  292 | 
  293 | def regulate(t: SupervisoryTargets, state: PlantState) -> Optional[dict]:
  294 |     """Setpoints -> valve positions (absolute %). None = the model holds."""
  295 |     if all(v is None for v in (t.pressure_sp, t.level_sp, t.production_rate_sp, t.a_comp_sp)):
  296 |         return None
  297 |     p_sp = t.pressure_sp if t.pressure_sp is not None else DESIGN_POINT["pressure"]
  298 |     l_sp = t.level_sp if t.level_sp is not None else DESIGN_POINT["level"]
  299 |     prod = t.production_rate_sp if t.production_rate_sp is not None else DESIGN_POINT["production"]
  300 |     over = state.pressure - p_sp
  301 |     scale = prod / DESIGN_POINT["production"]
  302 |     if over > 0:
  303 |         scale *= max(0.25, 1.0 - over / FEED_CUT_KPA)
  304 |     else:
  305 |         scale *= 1.0 + min(FEED_BOOST_MAX, -over / FEED_BOOST_KPA)
  306 |     return {
  307 |         "f1": _clamp(DESIGN_VALVES["f1"] * scale),
  308 |         "f2": _clamp(DESIGN_VALVES["f2"] * scale),
  309 |         "purge": _clamp(DESIGN_VALVES["purge"] + KP_PURGE * over),   # design purge vents feed-1 inerts
  310 |         "product": _clamp(DESIGN_VALVES["product"] + KL_PRODUCT * (state.level - l_sp)
  311 |                           + KP_PRODUCT_P * max(0.0, over)),
  312 |     }
  313 | 
  314 | 
  315 | def plant_state(raw: dict) -> PlantState:
  316 |     m, s, o = raw.get("measured", {}), raw.get("state", {}), raw.get("outputs", {})
  317 |     return PlantState(
  318 |         pressure=m.get("pressure", 0.0), level=m.get("liquid_level", 0.0),
  319 |         f1_flow=m.get("f1_flow", 0.0), f2_flow=m.get("f2_flow", 0.0),
  320 |         purge_flow=m.get("purge_flow", 0.0), product_flow=m.get("product_flow", 0.0),
  321 |         a_in_purge=m.get("A_in_purge", 0.0), b_in_purge=m.get("B_in_purge", 0.0),
  322 |         c_in_purge=m.get("C_in_purge", 0.0),
  323 |         f1_valve_pos=s.get("f1_valve_pos", 0.0), f2_valve_pos=s.get("f2_valve_pos", 0.0),
  324 |         purge_valve_pos=s.get("purge_valve_pos", 0.0), product_valve_pos=s.get("product_valve_pos", 0.0),
  325 |         cost=o.get("cost", 0.0))
  326 | 
  327 | 
  328 | class Activity:
  329 |     """Bounded feed of what the AI did, read by the page."""
  330 | 
  331 |     def __init__(self):
  332 |         self._lock, self._id, self.items = threading.Lock(), 0, deque(maxlen=300)
  333 | 
  334 |     def add(self, kind: str, text: str, **detail) -> None:
  335 |         with self._lock:
  336 |             self._id += 1
  337 |             self.items.append({"id": self._id, "ts": time.time(), "kind": kind, "text": text, **detail})
  338 | 
  339 |     def since(self, i: int) -> list:
  340 |         with self._lock:
  341 |             return [x for x in self.items if x["id"] > i]
  342 | 
  343 | 
  344 | class Rescue:
  345 |     """Closed loop: trained model -> regulate() -> valves, every TICK_S.
  346 | 
  347 |     Each engagement gets its own stop event and run id, so a quick Stop -> Save cannot
  348 |     leave an old loop running beside the new one, and an old loop can never change the
  349 |     state of a newer one when it exits."""
  350 | 
  351 |     def __init__(self, plant, activity: Activity):
  352 |         self.plant, self.activity = plant, activity
  353 |         self.active = False
  354 |         self._lock = threading.Lock()
  355 |         self._run_id = 0
  356 |         self._stop_evt: Optional[threading.Event] = None
  357 |         self._write_lock = getattr(plant, "_control", threading.RLock())
  358 | 
  359 |     def start(self) -> None:
  360 |         with self._write_lock, self._lock:
  361 |             if self.active:
  362 |                 return
  363 |             self._run_id += 1
  364 |             run_id, stop = self._run_id, threading.Event()
  365 |             self._stop_evt, self.active = stop, True
  366 |         threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(run_id, stop), name=f"ai-rescue-{run_id}",
  367 |                          daemon=True).start()
  368 | 
  369 |     def stop(self, why: str = "operator took manual control") -> None:
  370 |         with self._write_lock, self._lock:
  371 |             if not self.active:
  372 |                 return
  373 |             if self._stop_evt is not None:
  374 |                 self._stop_evt.set()
  375 |             self.active = False
  376 |         self.activity.add("info", f"AI disengaged: {why}. Manual control.")
  377 | 
  378 |     def _apply(self, run_id: int, stop: threading.Event, valves: dict) -> bool:
  379 |         with self._write_lock:
  380 |             if stop.is_set() or not self.active or run_id != self._run_id:
  381 |                 return False
  382 |             self.plant.apply_valves(valves, source="ai")
  383 |             return True
  384 | 
  385 |     def _finish(self, run_id: int, kind: str, text: str) -> None:
  386 |         """End this run, unless it was already stopped or superseded by a newer run."""
  387 |         with self._lock:
  388 |             if not (self.active and self._run_id == run_id):
  389 |                 return
  390 |             self.active = False
  391 |         self.activity.add(kind, text)
  392 | 
  393 |     def _run(self, run_id: int, stop: threading.Event) -> None:
  394 |         op = OllamaOperator(interval_s=0.0, background=False)
  395 |         self.activity.add("info", f"AI engaged: trained {op.model} is flying the plant "
  396 |                                   f"(decision every {TICK_S:g}s). Goal: back to "
  397 |                                   f"{DESIGN_POINT['pressure']:g} kPa / {DESIGN_POINT['level']:g}%.")
  398 |         t0, near, io_fails, model_fails = time.monotonic(), 0, 0, 0
  399 |         write_fails = 0     # separate: a successful read resets io_fails every tick
  400 |         end = ("info", "AI disengaged. Manual control.")
  401 |         try:
  402 |             while not stop.is_set():
  403 |                 tick = time.monotonic()
  404 |                 if self.plant.ruptured:
  405 |                     end = ("error", "Reactor ruptured: nothing left to save. AI disengaged.")
  406 |                     break
  407 |                 if self.plant.resetting:
  408 |                     end = ("info", "Simulation is resetting. AI disengaged.")
  409 |                     break
  410 |                 try:
  411 |                     raw = self.plant.read()
  412 |                     if raw.get("state", {}).get("e_stop"):
  413 |                         end = ("error", "Emergency stop is engaged. Release it explicitly before restarting AI.")
  414 |                         break
  415 |                     state = plant_state(raw)
  416 |                 except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
  417 |                     io_fails += 1
  418 |                     if io_fails >= MAX_IO_FAILS:
  419 |                         end = ("error", f"Plant unreachable for {io_fails} attempts ({type(e).__name__}). "
  420 |                                         "AI disengaged: take manual control.")
  421 |                         break
  422 |                     self.activity.add("error", f"Plant read failed ({type(e).__name__}); retrying "
  423 |                                                f"({io_fails}/{MAX_IO_FAILS}).")
  424 |                     stop.wait(TICK_S)
  425 |                     continue
  426 |                 io_fails = 0
  427 |                 targets = op.decide(state)                     # model call (parse, validate, clamp)
  428 |                 if stop.is_set():                              # stopped while the model was thinking
  429 |                     break
  430 |                 entry = op.log[-1] if op.log else {}
  431 |                 outcome = str(entry.get("outcome", ""))
  432 |                 model_fails = model_fails + 1 if outcome.startswith(("error", "parse_failed")) else 0
  433 |                 if model_fails >= MAX_MODEL_FAILS:
  434 |                     end = ("error", f"scram-operator gave no usable decision {model_fails} times in a row "
  435 |                                     f"({outcome[:80]}). AI disengaged: take manual control.")
  436 |                     break
  437 |                 valves = regulate(targets, state)
  438 |                 before = {v: round(getattr(state, f"{v}_valve_pos"), 1) for v in VALVES}
  439 |                 if valves is not None:
  440 |                     try:
  441 |                         if not self._apply(run_id, stop, valves):
  442 |                             break
  443 |                     except Exception as e:                  # noqa: BLE001 - ruptured / resetting / socket
  444 |                         if not (self.plant.ruptured or self.plant.resetting):
  445 |                             write_fails += 1
  446 |                             if write_fails >= MAX_IO_FAILS:
  447 |                                 end = ("error", f"Valve write failed {write_fails} times in a row "
  448 |                                                 f"({type(e).__name__}). AI disengaged: take manual control.")
  449 |                                 break
  450 |                             self.activity.add("error", f"Valve write failed ({type(e).__name__}); retrying "
  451 |                                                        f"({write_fails}/{MAX_IO_FAILS}).")

  453 |                         continue                             # ruptured / resetting handled at loop top
  454 |                     write_fails = 0
  455 |                 self.activity.add(
  456 |                     "decision",
  457 |                     targets.rationale,
  458 |                     saw={"pressure": round(state.pressure, 1), "level": round(state.level, 2)},
  459 |                     setpoints={"pressure": targets.pressure_sp, "level": targets.level_sp,
  460 |                                "production": targets.production_rate_sp, "a_comp": targets.a_comp_sp},

  463 |                 dp = abs(state.pressure - DESIGN_POINT["pressure"])
  464 |                 dl = abs(state.level - DESIGN_POINT["level"])
  465 |                 near = near + 1 if (dp <= NEAR_P_KPA and dl <= NEAR_L_PCT) else 0
  466 |                 if near >= NEAR_TICKS:
  467 |                     if stop.is_set():
  468 |                         break
  469 |                     if not self._apply(run_id, stop, dict(DESIGN_VALVES)):
  470 |                         break

  472 |                                    f"{state.level:.1f}% (design {DESIGN_POINT['pressure']:g} kPa / "
  473 |                                    f"{DESIGN_POINT['level']:g}%) after {time.monotonic() - t0:.0f}s. "
  474 |                                    "Valves left at the design lineup. Manual control.")
  475 |                     break
  476 |                 if time.monotonic() - t0 > MAX_RESCUE_S:
  477 |                     end = ("error", f"Not back near the design point after {MAX_RESCUE_S:.0f}s. "
  478 |                                     "AI disengaged: take manual control.")
  479 |                     break
  480 |                 stop.wait(max(0.0, TICK_S - (time.monotonic() - tick)))
  481 |         except Exception as e:                              # noqa: BLE001
  482 |             end = ("error", f"AI loop error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}. AI disengaged: take manual control.")
  483 |         finally:

   66 |     @wraps(fn)
   67 |     def guarded(self, *args, **kwargs):
   68 |         with self._control:
   69 |             return fn(self, *args, **kwargs)
   70 |     return guarded
   71 | 
   72 | 
   73 | class Plant:
   74 |     """Owns the simulator connection, the trend history and the rupture latch."""
   75 | 
   76 |     def __init__(self, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 55555):
   77 |         self.host, self.port = host, port
   78 |         self._io = threading.Lock()          # one request at a time on the socket
   79 |         self._control = threading.RLock()    # control ownership and E-stop precede valve writes
   80 |         self._data = threading.Lock()
   81 |         self._estop_latched = False
   82 |         self._stop_poll = threading.Event()
   83 |         self._poll_thread = None
   84 |         self._client: Optional[GrficsClient] = None
   85 |         self.raw: dict = {}
   86 |         self.connected = False
   87 |         self.resetting = False
   88 |         self._reset_lock = threading.Lock()   # one reset at a time, whoever asks
   89 |         self.setpoints: dict = {}
   90 |         self.history: deque = deque(maxlen=HISTORY_N)
   91 |         self.seq = 0
   92 |         self.t0 = time.monotonic()
   93 |         self._clear_rupture()
   94 |         self.activity = Activity()
   95 |         self.rescue = Rescue(self, self.activity)
   96 | 
   97 |     # ---- socket -------------------------------------------------------------
   98 |     def _txn(self, fn):
   99 |         with self._io:
  100 |             try:
  101 |                 if self._client is None:
  102 |                     self._client = GrficsClient(self.host, self.port, timeout=3.0).connect()
  103 |                 return fn(self._client)
  104 |             except (OSError, ValueError):
  105 |                 if self._client is not None:
  106 |                     self._client.close()
  107 |                 self._client = None
  108 |                 raise
  109 | 
  110 |     def read(self) -> dict:
  111 |         return self._txn(lambda c: c.read())
  112 | 
  113 |     def write(self, inputs: dict) -> dict:
  114 |         return self._txn(lambda c: c.write_inputs(inputs))
  115 | 
  116 |     # ---- polling ------------------------------------------------------------
  117 |     def _clear_rupture(self) -> None:
  118 |         self.ruptured, self.ruptured_t, self.rupture_pressure, self.peak_pressure = False, None, None, 0.0
  119 | 
  120 |     @_serialized
  121 |     def start(self) -> "Plant":
  122 |         if self._poll_thread is not None and self._poll_thread.is_alive():
  123 |             return self
  124 |         self._stop_poll.clear()
  125 |         self._poll_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._poll, name="plant-poll", daemon=True)
  126 |         self._poll_thread.start()
  127 |         return self
  128 | 
  129 |     def stop(self) -> None:
  130 |         self._stop_poll.set()
  131 |         self.rescue.stop("application shutdown")
  132 |         if self._poll_thread is not None:
  133 |             self._poll_thread.join(timeout=4.0)
  134 |         with self._io:
  135 |             if self._client is not None:
  136 |                 self._client.close()
  137 |                 self._client = None
  138 |         self.connected = False
  139 | 
  140 |     def _poll(self) -> None:
  141 |         while not self._stop_poll.is_set():
  142 |             if not self.resetting:
  143 |                 try:
  144 |                     with self._control:
  145 |                         raw = self.read()
  146 |                         if self._estop_latched and not raw.get("state", {}).get("e_stop"):
  147 |                             raw = self.write({"e_stop": 1})
  148 |                         self._ingest(raw)
  149 |                 except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
  150 |                     self.connected = False
  151 |             self._stop_poll.wait(POLL_S)
  152 | 
  153 |     def _ingest(self, raw: dict) -> None:
  154 |         o, s = raw.get("outputs", {}), raw.get("state", {})
  155 |         t = round(time.monotonic() - self.t0, 1)
  156 |         p = _num(o.get("pressure"))
  157 |         with self._data:
  158 |             self.raw, self.connected = raw, True
  159 |             # Valves follow their setpoint instantly in this sim, except that e_stop forces
  160 |             # 0/0/100/100 and those positions persist after release. Mirroring the plant keeps
  161 |             # the +/- steps based on where each valve really is, however it got there.
  162 |             if s:
  163 |                 self.setpoints = {v: _num(s.get(f"{v}_valve_pos")) for v in VALVES}
  164 |             self.peak_pressure = max(self.peak_pressure, p)
  165 |             if not self.ruptured and p >= RUPTURE_THRESHOLD_KPA:
  166 |                 self.ruptured, self.ruptured_t, self.rupture_pressure = True, t, round(p, 1)
  167 |             self.seq += 1
  168 |             self.history.append([self.seq, t, round(p, 2), round(_num(o.get("liquid_level")), 3),
  169 |                                  *(round(_num(o.get(f"{v}_flow")), 2) for v in VALVES),
  170 |                                  *(round(_num(s.get(f"{v}_valve_pos")), 2) for v in VALVES)])
  171 | 
  172 |     # ---- views / actions ----------------------------------------------------
  173 |     def snapshot(self, since: int = 0) -> dict:
  174 |         with self._data:
  175 |             o, s = self.raw.get("outputs", {}), self.raw.get("state", {})
  176 |             return {
  177 |                 "connected": self.connected, "resetting": self.resetting,
  178 |                 "t": round(time.monotonic() - self.t0, 1),
  179 |                 "pressure": o.get("pressure"), "level": o.get("liquid_level"),
  180 |                 "flows": {v: o.get(f"{v}_flow") for v in VALVES},
  181 |                 "composition_purge": {"A": o.get("A_in_purge"), "B": o.get("B_in_purge"),
  182 |                                       "C": o.get("C_in_purge")},
  183 |                 "cost": o.get("cost"),
  184 |                 "valves": {v: s.get(f"{v}_valve_pos") for v in VALVES},
  185 |                 "setpoints": dict(self.setpoints),
  186 |                 "e_stop": self._estop_latched or bool(s.get("e_stop", False)),
  187 |                 "e_stop_pending": self._estop_latched and not bool(s.get("e_stop", False)),
  188 |                 "ruptured": self.ruptured, "exploded": self.ruptured,
  189 |                 "ruptured_t": self.ruptured_t, "rupture_pressure": self.rupture_pressure,
  190 |                 "peak_pressure": round(self.peak_pressure, 1),
  191 |                 "rupture_threshold": RUPTURE_THRESHOLD_KPA, "pressure_ceiling": PRESSURE_CEILING_KPA,
  192 |                 "history": [h for h in self.history if h[0] > since],
  193 |             }
  194 | 
  195 |     def _check_writable(self, source: str, valves: bool = True) -> None:
  196 |         if self.resetting:
  197 |             raise HTTPException(409, "simulation is resetting")
  198 |         if self.ruptured:
  199 |             raise HTTPException(409, "the reactor has ruptured; reset the simulation")
  200 |         if source == "manual" and self.rescue.active:
  201 |             raise HTTPException(409, "the AI is in control; press 'Stop AI' to take manual control")
  202 |         if valves and (self._estop_latched or self.raw.get("state", {}).get("e_stop")):
  203 |             # the simulator ignores valve setpoints while e_stop is on
  204 |             raise HTTPException(409, "E-STOP is engaged; release it before moving valves")
  205 | 
  206 |     @_serialized
  207 |     def apply_valves(self, valves: dict, source: str = "manual") -> None:
  208 |         """Write several valve setpoints at once (clamped to 0-100)."""
  209 |         self._check_writable(source)
  210 |         if any(not math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in valves.values()):
  211 |             raise HTTPException(422, "valve values must be finite")
  212 |         new = {v: max(0.0, min(100.0, float(x))) for v, x in valves.items() if v in VALVES}
  213 |         raw = self.write({f"{v}_valve_sp": x for v, x in new.items()})
  214 |         with self._data:
  215 |             self.setpoints.update(new)
  216 |         self._ingest(raw)
  217 | 
  218 |     @_serialized
  219 |     def manipulate(self, variable: str, delta: Optional[float], value: Optional[float],
  220 |                    source: str = "manual") -> dict:
  221 |         if variable not in (*VALVES, "e_stop"):
  222 |             raise HTTPException(422, "unknown valve")
  223 |         if any(x is not None and not math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in (delta, value)):
  224 |             raise HTTPException(422, "delta and value must be finite")
  225 |         if variable == "e_stop":
  226 |             on = bool(value) if value is not None else not (self._estop_latched or bool(self.raw.get("state", {}).get("e_stop")))
  227 |             if on:
  228 |                 self._estop_latched = True
  229 |                 self.rescue.stop("emergency stop")
  230 |             else:
  231 |                 self._check_writable(source, valves=False)
  232 |             try:
  233 |                 raw = self.write({"e_stop": int(on)})
  234 |             except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
  235 |                 raise HTTPException(503, f"plant not reachable: {e}") from e
  236 |             self._ingest(raw)
  237 |             self._estop_latched = on
  238 |             return {"variable": "e_stop", "value": on}
  239 |         self._check_writable(source)
  240 |         if (delta is None) == (value is None):
  241 |             raise HTTPException(422, "give exactly one of delta or value")
  242 |         with self._data:
  243 |             base = self.setpoints.get(variable, 0.0)
  244 |         new = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(value) if value is not None else base + float(delta)))
  245 |         try:
  246 |             raw = self.write({f"{variable}_valve_sp": new})
  247 |         except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
  248 |             raise HTTPException(503, f"plant not reachable: {e}") from e
  249 |         with self._data:
  250 |             self.setpoints[variable] = new
  251 |         self._ingest(raw)
  252 |         return {"variable": variable, "setpoint": new}
  253 | 
  254 |     def reset(self) -> dict:
  255 |         if not self._reset_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
  256 |             raise HTTPException(409, "already resetting")
  257 |         with self._control:
  258 |             self.resetting = True
  259 |             self.rescue.stop("simulation reset")
  260 |             self._estop_latched = False
  261 |         try:
  262 |             with self._io:
  263 |                 if self._client is not None:
  264 |                     self._client.close()
  265 |                 self._client = None
  266 |             point = reset_and_settle()          # docker compose restart + wait settled
  267 |             with self._data:
  268 |                 self._clear_rupture()
  269 |                 self.history.clear()
  270 |                 self.setpoints = {}
  271 |                 self.t0 = time.monotonic()
  272 |             with self._control:
  273 |                 self._ingest(self.write({"e_stop": 1}) if self._estop_latched else self.read())
  274 |             return {"pressure": point.pressure, "level": point.level,
  275 |                     "cycles_to_settle": point.cycles_to_settle}
  276 |         except Exception as e:                  # noqa: BLE001
  277 |             raise HTTPException(500, f"reset failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}") from e
  278 |         finally:
  279 |             self.resetting = False
  280 |             self._reset_lock.release()
  281 | 
  282 | 
  283 | class Manipulation(BaseModel):
  284 |     variable: Literal["f1", "f2", "purge", "product", "e_stop"]
  285 |     delta: Optional[float] = None
  286 |     value: Optional[float] = None
  287 | 
  288 |     @model_validator(mode="after")
  289 |     def one_of(self):
  290 |         if any(x is not None and not math.isfinite(x) for x in (self.delta, self.value)):
  291 |             raise ValueError("delta and value must be finite")
  292 |         if self.variable != "e_stop" and (self.delta is None) == (self.value is None):
  293 |             raise ValueError("give exactly one of 'delta' or 'value'")
  294 |         return self

  323 | class Command(BaseModel):
  324 |     text: str
  325 | 
  326 | 
  327 | @app.post("/api/command")
  328 | def command(c: Command) -> dict:
  329 |     """Plain English -> one or more actions (stock qwen2.5:1.5b), applied in the order given,
  330 |     each exactly like a manual move. Each action's outcome is reported on its own; one
  331 |     refused action does not stop the others."""
  332 |     text = c.text.strip()[:300]
  333 |     if not text:
  334 |         raise HTTPException(400, "empty command")
  335 |     try:
  336 |         parsed = parse_commands(text)
  337 |     except Exception as e:                      # noqa: BLE001
  338 |         plant.activity.add("error", f'"{text}": language model unavailable ({type(e).__name__})', command=text)
  339 |         raise HTTPException(503, f"language model unavailable: {e}") from e
  340 |     steps = []
  341 |     for a in parsed["actions"]:
  342 |         act, valve, amount = a["action"], a["valve"], a["amount"]
  343 |         step = {k: a[k] for k in ("clause", "action", "valve", "amount", "corrections")}
  344 |         try:
  345 |             if act == "rescue":
  346 |                 step["result"], step["message"] = rescue(), "AI rescue engaged"
  347 |             elif act == "stop":
  348 |                 step["result"], step["message"] = stop_ai(), "AI stopped; manual control"
  349 |             elif act in ("adjust", "set"):
  350 |                 r = plant.manipulate(valve, amount if act == "adjust" else None, amount if act == "set" else None)
  351 |                 step["result"], step["message"] = r, f"{valve} setpoint -> {r['setpoint']:.1f}%"
  352 |             else:
  353 |                 step["error"] = "not understood as a valve command"
  354 |         except HTTPException as e:
  355 |             step["error"] = str(e.detail)
  356 |         step["ok"] = "error" not in step
  357 |         steps.append(step)
  358 |     summary = "; ".join(st["message"] if st["ok"] else f'"{st["clause"] or text}": {st["error"]}' for st in steps)
  359 |     info = {"command": text, "actions": steps, "model_output": parsed["model_output"],
  360 |             "latency_s": parsed["latency_s"]}
  361 |     ok = [st for st in steps if st["ok"]]
  362 |     plant.activity.add("command" if ok else "error", summary, **info)
  363 |     if not ok:
  364 |         if all(st["action"] == "unknown" for st in steps):
  365 |             raise HTTPException(422, "not understood as a valve command")
  366 |         raise HTTPException(409, summary)
  367 |     first = steps[0]
  368 |     return {**info, "message": summary,
  369 |             # single-action fields, kept for existing clients
  370 |             "parsed": {k: first[k] for k in ("action", "valve", "amount")},
  371 |             "corrections": [c for st in steps for c in st["corrections"]],
  372 |             "result": first.get("result")}
  373 | 
  374 |

  380 |     return {"active": True}

  129 | const feed = [];

  131 | // ---------- requests
  132 | 
  133 | /** @param {string} url @param {RequestInit} [init] */
  134 | async function fetchWithTimeout(url, init = {}) {
  135 |   const ctl = new AbortController();
  136 |   const timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
  137 |   try { return await fetch(url, {...init, signal: ctl.signal}); }
  138 |   finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
  139 | }
  140 | 
  141 | /** POST JSON; throws an Error carrying the server's message on a non-2xx reply. */
  142 | async function post(/** @type {string} */ url, /** @type {object} */ body = {}) {
  143 |   // reset and the AI model can take a while, so only the poll uses the short timeout
  144 |   const res = await fetch(url, {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(body)});
  145 |   const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  146 |   if (!res.ok) {
  147 |     const d = data.detail;
  148 |     throw new Error(typeof d === "string" ? d : d ? "request rejected" : res.statusText || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
  149 |   }
  150 |   return data;
  151 | }
  152 | 
  153 | /** @type {number | undefined} */
  154 | let toastTimer;
  155 | function toast(/** @type {string} */ msg, isError = false) {
  156 |   const t = $("toast");
  157 |   t.textContent = msg;
  158 |   t.className = "toast show" + (isError ? " err" : "");
  159 |   clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  160 |   toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove("show"), isError ? 5000 : 3000);
  161 | }

  163 | /** @param {{variable: Valve | "e_stop", value?: number, delta?: number}} body */
  164 | async function move(body) {
  165 |   try {
  166 |     const r = await post("/api/manipulate", body);
  167 |     toast(r.variable === "e_stop" ? `Emergency stop ${r.value ? "on" : "released"}`
  168 |                                   : `${SHORT[/** @type {Valve} */ (r.variable)]} → ${fmt(r.setpoint)}%`);
  169 |   } catch (e) { toast(errText(e), true); }
  170 | }
  171 | /** @param {unknown} e */
  172 | const errText = e => e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
  173 | 
  174 | // ---------- static DOM (gauge, valves, legend)
  175 | 
  176 | /** Gauge x position for a pressure. */
  177 | const GX = (/** @type {number} */ p) => 16 + 448 * (clamp(p, P_MIN, P_MAX) - P_MIN) / (P_MAX - P_MIN);
  178 | 
  179 | function buildGauge() {
  180 |   let ticks = "";
  181 |   for (let v = P_MIN; v <= P_MAX; v += 100) {
  182 |     const major = v % 200 === 0, x = GX(v).toFixed(1);
  183 |     ticks += `<line class="cr-tick ${major ? "maj" : ""}" x1="${x}" y1="74" x2="${x}" y2="${major ? 82 : 79}"/>`;
  184 |   }
  185 |   for (const v of [2200, 2600, 3000, 3200]) ticks += `<text class="cr-tlabel" x="${GX(v).toFixed(1)}" y="95" text-anchor="middle">${v}</text>`;
  186 |   /** @type {[number, number, string][]} */
  187 |   const bands = [[P_MIN, DESIGN, "ok"], [DESIGN, DANGER, "warn"], [DANGER, RUPT, "crit"], [RUPT, P_MAX, "rup"]];
  188 |   const bars = bands.map(([lo, hi, cls], i) => {
  189 |     const a = GX(lo) + (i ? 1.5 : 0), b = GX(hi);
  190 |     return `<rect class="cr-zbar-${cls}" x="${a.toFixed(1)}" y="58" width="${(b - a).toFixed(1)}" height="14" rx="2"/>`;
  191 |   }).join("");
  192 |   const marker = (/** @type {number} */ p, /** @type {string} */ label, /** @type {string} */ anchor) =>
  193 |     `<line class="cr-thr" x1="${GX(p).toFixed(1)}" y1="36" x2="${GX(p).toFixed(1)}" y2="58"/>` +
  194 |     `<text class="cr-thrlabel" x="${GX(p).toFixed(1)}" y="31" text-anchor="${anchor}">${label}</text>`;
  195 |   $("gauge").innerHTML = bars + ticks + marker(DESIGN, "DESIGN", "middle") + marker(RUPT, "RUPTURE", "end") +
  196 |     `<g class="cr-ptr" id="ptr" transform="translate(${GX(DESIGN).toFixed(1)} 0)">` +
  197 |     `<path class="cr-ptr-head" d="M-6 44 L6 44 L0 54 Z"/><line class="cr-ptr-line" x1="0" y1="50" x2="0" y2="86"/></g>`;
  198 | }
  199 | 
  200 | /** Per-valve elements, looked up once. */
  201 | /** @type {Record<Valve, {pos: HTMLElement, sp: HTMLElement, fill: HTMLElement, input: HTMLInputElement}>} */
  202 | const valveEls = /** @type {any} */ ({});

  204 | function buildValves() {

  207 |       <div class="valve-h"><span class="nm">${name}</span><span class="vv" data-vv>—</span></div>

  209 |       <div class="valve-sub">${sub}</div>
  210 |       <div class="valve-track"><div class="valve-fill" data-vf style="width:0%"></div></div>
  211 |       <div class="valve-ctl">
  212 |         <button class="step" type="button" data-d="-5" title="Close 5%">-5</button>
  213 |         <button class="step" type="button" data-d="-1" title="Close 1%">-1</button>
  214 |         <button class="step" type="button" data-d="1" title="Open 1%">+1</button>
  215 |         <button class="step" type="button" data-d="5" title="Open 5%">+5</button>
  216 |         <input type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" data-in placeholder="%" aria-label="${name} position (%)">
  217 |         <button class="apply" type="button" data-apply>Set</button>
  218 |       </div>

  220 |   for (const [k] of VALVES) {
  221 |     const row = /** @type {HTMLElement} */ (document.querySelector(`.valve[data-valve="${k}"]`));
  222 |     const q = (/** @type {string} */ sel) => /** @type {HTMLElement} */ (row.querySelector(sel));
  223 |     valveEls[k] = {pos: q("[data-vv]"), sp: q("[data-sp]"), fill: q("[data-vf]"), input: /** @type {HTMLInputElement} */ (q("[data-in]"))};
  224 |   }
  225 | }

  227 | function buildLegend() {

  230 | 
  231 | // ---------- AI feed (backend activity -> decision cards)
  232 | 
  233 | /** @param {Record<string, [number, number]> | null | undefined} v */
  234 | function moves(v) {
  235 |   if (!v) return "no valve change";
  236 |   const changed = Object.entries(v).filter(([, [a, b]]) => Math.abs(a - b) >= 0.1);
  237 |   return changed.length ? changed.map(([k, [a, b]]) => `${SHORT[/** @type {Valve} */ (k)] ?? k} ${fmt(a)}→${fmt(b)}%`).join(" · ")
  238 |                         : "no valve change";
  239 | }
  240 | 
  241 | function trend() {
  242 |   if (hist.length < 6) return "steady";
  243 |   const d = hist[hist.length - 1][2] - hist[hist.length - 6][2];
  244 |   return d > 2 ? "rising" : d < -2 ? "falling" : "steady";
  245 | }
  246 | 
  247 | /** The measured plant state, shown beside a decision. Only meaningful for live events. */
  248 | function truthLine(/** @type {Activity} */ a) {
  249 |   if (!plant || plant.pressure === null || Date.now() / 1000 - a.ts > 5) return null;
  250 |   return `P ${fmt(plant.pressure, 0)} kPa, ${trend()} · L ${fmt(plant.level)}% · purge ${fmt(plant.valves.purge)}% · feed 1 ${fmt(plant.valves.f1)}%`;
  251 | }
  252 | 
  253 | /** @param {Activity} a @returns {FeedEntry} */
  254 | function toFeed(a) {
  255 |   const time = timeOf(a.ts);
  256 |   if (a.kind === "decision") {
  257 |     const saw = a.saw ? `saw P ${fmt(a.saw.pressure, 0)} kPa, L ${fmt(a.saw.level)}% · ` : "";
  258 |     const asked = a.setpoints?.pressure !== undefined ? `asked P→${fmt(a.setpoints.pressure, 0)} · ` : "";
  259 |     return {time, cls: "", tag: "DECISION", say: esc(a.text), meta: saw + asked + esc(moves(a.valves)), tel: truthLine(a)};
  260 |   }
  261 |   if (Array.isArray(a.actions)) {
  262 |     const steps = a.actions.map(s => s.ok ? esc((s.message ?? "").replace(" setpoint -> ", " → "))
  263 |                                           : `<span class="err">${esc(s.clause || "?")}: ${esc(s.error)}</span>`);
  264 |     const fixes = a.actions.flatMap(s => s.corrections ?? []);
  265 |     return {time, cls: a.kind === "error" ? "alarm" : "", tag: "COMMAND", say: `“${esc(a.command)}”`,
  266 |             meta: steps.join(" · ") + (fixes.length ? ` · corrected: ${esc(fixes.join("; "))}` : ""), tel: null};
  267 |   }
  268 |   if (a.kind === "error") return {time, cls: "alarm", tag: "ALARM", say: esc(a.text), meta: "", tel: null};
  269 |   if (a.kind === "done") return {time, cls: "engage", tag: "STABILISED", say: esc(a.text), meta: "", tel: truthLine(a)};
  270 |   const engage = a.text.startsWith("AI engaged");
  271 |   return {time, cls: engage ? "engage" : "", tag: engage ? "ENGAGE" : "INFO", say: esc(a.text), meta: "", tel: null};
  272 | }
  273 | 
  274 | function renderFeed() {
  275 |   const body = $("aiBody");
  276 |   if (!feed.length) {
  277 |     body.innerHTML = `<div class="ai-idle">Type a plain-English command (several at once is fine), or press <b>Save the reactor</b> to hand control to the trained model. Its decisions appear here with the measured readings beside each one.</div>`;
  278 |     return;
  279 |   }
  280 |   const old = body.querySelector(".ai-list");
  281 |   const scrolled = old ? old.scrollTop : 0;          // keep the reader's place when new entries arrive
  282 |   body.innerHTML = `<div class="ai-list">` + feed.map(d => `<div class="dec ${d.cls}">
  283 |     <div class="dec-h"><span class="dec-t">${d.time}</span><span class="dec-tag">${d.tag}</span></div>
  284 |     <div class="dec-say">${d.say}</div>${d.meta ? `<div class="dec-meta">${d.meta}</div>` : ""}${d.tel ? `<div class="dec-tel">${esc(d.tel)}</div>` : ""}</div>`).join("") + `</div>`;
  285 |   if (scrolled) /** @type {HTMLElement} */ (body.querySelector(".ai-list")).scrollTop = scrolled;
  286 | }

  290 | function render() {
  291 |   const s = plant;
  292 |   const station = $("station");
  293 |   if (!s) { $("chip").textContent = serverUp ? "CONNECTING" : "SERVER DOWN"; return; }
  294 |   const ai = !!s.ai?.active;
  295 |   const p = s.pressure;
  296 |   const z = zone(p ?? DESIGN, s.ruptured);
  297 |   const resetting = s.resetting || resettingHere;
  298 |   const offline = !serverUp || !s.connected;
  299 | 
  300 |   station.classList.toggle("ai-on", ai);
  301 |   station.classList.toggle("ruptured", s.ruptured);
  302 |   station.classList.toggle("estopped", s.e_stop && !ai && !s.ruptured);
  303 |   $("clock").textContent = fmtClock(s.t);
  304 |   $("clock").title = "time since the server started";
  305 |   $("chip").textContent = !serverUp ? "SERVER DOWN" : resetting ? "RESETTING" : !s.connected ? "NO PLANT"
  306 |     : s.ruptured ? "RUPTURE" : s.e_stop_pending ? "E-STOP REQUESTED" : ai ? "AI IN CONTROL" : s.e_stop ? "E-STOP" : "MANUAL";
  307 | 
  308 |   // pressure instrument
  309 |   $("pVal").textContent = fmt(p, 0);
  310 |   const zoneEl = $("zone");
  311 |   zoneEl.textContent = p === null ? "No data" : z.label;
  312 |   zoneEl.className = "cr-zone " + (p === null ? "" : z.cls);
  313 |   const led = $("led"), col = cssVar(p === null ? "--dim" : z.col);
  314 |   led.style.background = col;
  315 |   led.style.boxShadow = "0 0 10px " + col;
  316 |   $("ptr").setAttribute("transform", `translate(${GX(p ?? DESIGN).toFixed(1)} 0)`);
  317 |   $("lVal").textContent = fmt(s.level) + "%";
  318 |   $("fVal").textContent = fmt(s.flows.product);
  319 |   $("hudP").textContent = fmt(p, 0) + " kPa";
  320 |   $("hudP").style.color = col;
  321 |   $("hudL").textContent = "Level " + fmt(s.level) + "%";
  322 |   $("viewNote").textContent = s.ruptured ? `ruptured at ${fmt(s.rupture_pressure, 0)} kPa · reset required` : "live · GRFICS 3D";
  323 | 
  324 |   // valves
  325 |   for (const [k] of VALVES) {
  326 |     const el = valveEls[k], pos = s.valves[k];
  327 |     el.pos.textContent = fmt(pos) + "%";
  328 |     el.sp.textContent = "sp " + fmt(s.setpoints[k] ?? pos) + "%";
  329 |     el.fill.style.width = clamp(pos ?? 0, 0, 100) + "%";
  330 |   }
  331 |   const locked = s.ruptured || resetting || offline || ai;
  332 |   document.querySelectorAll("#valveList button, #valveList input").forEach(el => {
  333 |     /** @type {HTMLButtonElement | HTMLInputElement} */ (el).disabled = locked || s.e_stop;
  334 |   });
  335 |   const es = button("btnEstop");
  336 |   es.disabled = resetting || offline || s.ruptured;
  337 |   es.classList.toggle("on", s.e_stop);
  338 |   es.textContent = s.e_stop ? "RELEASE EMERGENCY STOP" : "EMERGENCY STOP";
  339 |   const lockMsg = s.ruptured ? "Reactor ruptured. Reset the plant to continue."
  340 |     : resetting ? "Resetting. Controls are locked."
  341 |     : offline ? "Waiting for the plant."
  342 |     : ai ? "AI in control. Manual valves are locked."
  343 |     : s.e_stop ? "Emergency stop is on. Release it to move valves." : "";
  344 |   $("lockText").textContent = lockMsg;
  345 |   $("lockrow").classList.toggle("show", !!lockMsg);
  346 | 
  347 |   // AI and reset
  348 |   $("aiState").textContent = s.ruptured ? "halted" : ai ? "in control" : "idle";
  349 |   button("btnSave").disabled = locked;
  350 |   button("btnStop").disabled = !ai || !serverUp;
  351 |   button("btnSend").disabled = !serverUp;
  352 |   button("btnReset").disabled = resetting || !serverUp;
  353 |   $("busy").hidden = !resetting;
  354 | 
  355 |   drawGraphs();
  356 | }

  358 | // ---------- charts
  359 | 
  360 | /** Size a canvas to its box at device resolution; returns the context and CSS size. */
  361 | function setup(/** @type {HTMLCanvasElement} */ c) {
  362 |   const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1), r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
  363 |   const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width * dpr)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height * dpr));
  364 |   if (c.width !== w || c.height !== h) { c.width = w; c.height = h; }
  365 |   const x = /** @type {CanvasRenderingContext2D} */ (c.getContext("2d"));
  366 |   x.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  367 |   x.clearRect(0, 0, r.width, r.height);
  368 |   return /** @type {const} */ ([x, r.width, r.height]);
  369 | }
  370 | 
  371 | /**
  372 |  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} x @param {number[]} data
  373 |  * @param {(i: number) => number} X @param {(v: number) => number} Y
  374 |  * @param {string} color @param {number} [fillTo]  y to shade down to
  375 |  */
  376 | function drawSeries(x, data, X, Y, color, fillTo) {
  377 |   if (data.length < 2) return;
  378 |   const path = () => { x.beginPath(); data.forEach((v, i) => i ? x.lineTo(X(i), Y(v)) : x.moveTo(X(i), Y(v))); };
  379 |   if (fillTo !== undefined) {
  380 |     const g = x.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, fillTo);
  381 |     g.addColorStop(0, color + "33"); g.addColorStop(1, color + "00");
  382 |     path(); x.lineTo(X(data.length - 1), fillTo); x.lineTo(X(0), fillTo); x.closePath();
  383 |     x.fillStyle = g; x.fill();
  384 |   }
  385 |   path(); x.strokeStyle = color; x.lineWidth = 2; x.stroke();
  386 | }
  387 | 
  388 | function drawGraphs() {
  389 |   const rows = hist.slice(-KEEP);
  390 |   const n = Math.max(2, rows.length);
  391 |   const P = rows.map(r => r[2]), L = rows.map(r => r[3]);
  392 |   const accent = cssVar("--accent"), dim = cssVar("--dim"), line = cssVar("--line"), crit = cssVar("--crit");
  393 |   const mono = "12px " + cssVar("--font-mono");
  394 | 
  395 |   // pressure, fixed 2200-3200 kPa so the bands are always in the same place
  396 |   {
  397 |     const [x, w, h] = setup(canvas("gPressure"));
  398 |     const pad = {l: 38, r: 8, t: 8, b: 16}, lo = P_MIN, hi = P_MAX;
  399 |     const X = (/** @type {number} */ i) => pad.l + (w - pad.l - pad.r) * i / (n - 1);
  400 |     const Y = (/** @type {number} */ v) => pad.t + (h - pad.t - pad.b) * (1 - (clamp(v, lo, hi) - lo) / (hi - lo));
  401 |     x.font = mono;
  402 |     for (const v of [2400, 2700, 3000]) {
  403 |       x.strokeStyle = line; x.globalAlpha = .5; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(pad.l, Y(v)); x.lineTo(w - pad.r, Y(v)); x.stroke();
  404 |       x.globalAlpha = 1; x.fillStyle = dim; x.fillText(String(v), 4, Y(v) + 3);
  405 |     }
  406 |     x.strokeStyle = crit; x.setLineDash([5, 4]); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(pad.l, Y(RUPT)); x.lineTo(w - pad.r, Y(RUPT)); x.stroke(); x.setLineDash([]);
  407 |     x.fillStyle = crit; x.textAlign = "right"; x.fillText("3100 rupture", w - pad.r, Y(RUPT) - 4); x.textAlign = "left";
  408 |     drawSeries(x, P, X, Y, accent, h - pad.b);
  409 |     if (P.length) {
  410 |       const last = P[P.length - 1];
  411 |       x.fillStyle = cssVar(zone(last, !!plant?.ruptured).col);
  412 |       x.beginPath(); x.arc(X(P.length - 1), Y(last), 3.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI); x.fill();
  413 |     }
  414 |   }
  415 |   // level, 20-80 % unless the data leaves that band
  416 |   {
  417 |     const [x, w, h] = setup(canvas("gLevel"));
  418 |     const lo = Math.min(20, ...L), hi = Math.max(80, ...L);
  419 |     const X = (/** @type {number} */ i) => 30 + (w - 34) * i / (n - 1);
  420 |     const Y = (/** @type {number} */ v) => 6 + (h - 18) * (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo));
  421 |     x.font = mono; x.fillStyle = dim;
  422 |     for (const v of [lo, (lo + hi) / 2, hi]) x.fillText(String(Math.round(v)), 2, Y(v) + 3);
  423 |     drawSeries(x, L, X, Y, accent, h - 12);
  424 |   }
  425 |   // flows, four series on one scale
  426 |   {
  427 |     const [x, w, h] = setup(canvas("gFlows"));
  428 |     let fmax = 1;
  429 |     for (const r of rows) for (const k of VALVES) fmax = Math.max(fmax, r[FLOW_COL[k[0]]] || 0);
  430 |     const X = (/** @type {number} */ i) => 30 + (w - 34) * i / (n - 1);
  431 |     const Y = (/** @type {number} */ v) => 6 + (h - 14) * (1 - v / (fmax * 1.1));
  432 |     x.font = mono; x.fillStyle = dim;
  433 |     x.fillText(String(Math.round(fmax)), 2, Y(fmax) + 3); x.fillText("0", 2, Y(0));
  434 |     for (const [k] of VALVES) drawSeries(x, rows.map(r => r[FLOW_COL[k]] || 0), X, Y, FLOW_COLORS[k]);
  435 |   }
  436 | }

  438 | // ---------- 3D display: GRFICS rendered at desktop size, scaled to fill the screen,
  439 | // with its side menu and header cropped off
  440 | 
  441 | function fitView() {
  442 |   const vp = $("screen"), f = $("plant3d");
  443 |   const vw = 1400 - 270, vh = 900 - 40;
  444 |   const k = 1.03 * Math.max(vp.clientWidth / vw, vp.clientHeight / vh);   // 3% extra hides Unity's letterbox edges
  445 |   const dx = (vp.clientWidth - vw * k) / 2 - 270 * k, dy = (vp.clientHeight - vh * k) / 2 - 40 * k;
  446 |   f.style.transform = `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px) scale(${k})`;
  447 | }

  451 | function wireEvents() {
  452 |   new ResizeObserver(fitView).observe($("screen"));
  453 |   button("btnFull").addEventListener("click", () => {
  454 |     if (document.fullscreenElement) document.exitFullscreen();
  455 |     else $("screen").requestFullscreen().catch(() => toast("Full screen is not allowed here", true));
  456 |   });
